ENGLISH: The Insurrection has been crushed, the state of chaos has been ended. While it will take awhile to regain all that was lost, we can rest assured that Persia still stands tall, against all odds.

Iraq used our distraction during the civil war to declare an independent Iraqi state. We must crush this foolish dream in the cradle, Iraq is of vital importance for our position as ruler of the Middle East.

Shortly before the civil war the Steppe raiders seize some of our land to the east. This in combination with the civil war has left us as an unrecognized state, as some mere pretender. We must retake all the core lands of Persia so that we can be recognized as the true successors to the Persian Empire.

§GThis decision will unlock further decisions to integrate and accept Azerbaijan.§! The Armenians have long been a thorn in our side. They have been a steadfast ally of Cappadocia in their wars against us, serving as a shield protecting the Christian realm from our expansion. They also subject the Azeri people to humiliation and suppression of their beliefs. We must take up the cause of protecting Azerbaijan, as fellow muslims it is our duty.
Azerbaijan has been liberated from Armenia, they now hold all of their core lands. We can now begin the process of integrating them as a part of our Empire.

Syria used to be part of Persia, having been conquered from the Crusader states. As the wars with Cappadocia dragged on we elected to give some Turkic officers the status of nobility and gave them Syria to administer in our name. This did help us start to push back the Cappadocians, but as we became busy with the internal power struggle in the Islamic world and the Eastern flank of the Empire, relations deteriorated. This led to them marching into Cappadocian land, winning that war and then seeing this as proof that Persia was not needed for their success. Then, during our moment of weakness in the civil war, they declared independence. We elevated them to nobility, we gave them some of the richest land in the Middle East, and they betrayed us. While this grievance stands, the entire nation feels shame. We must rectify it and bring Syria back under Persian control.
The Eastern Border holds the key to trade with India and further expansion in the region. Ensuring that we control it will be of great help in our goal to restore our position in the world.
Our Position In The World Restored

We fell from grace, yet we persevered. We have through our determination and superiority reclaimed our position in the world, one of the true great powers. We have also become something more than just Persia, we are an empire consisting of many people, and the time has come to embrace that. Long live the Emperor, long live Iranzamin!
